resources.string: Connect people, records and visual memories in your workspaces.
Connect people, authorized records and visual evidence. From Android, with compatible glasses when you need them.
Review a case, find shared information or recall where an object was last seen.
Consult authorized case files, notes and evidence in your workspace. For people already enrolled, review possible matches and confirm their identity.
Open a case and review its notes and attachments in one place.
Review authorized patient records, history and prescriptions. Confirm the person and encounter before reviewing their information.
Open the patient record and compare medication details with the prescription.
Explore profiles, shared photos and posts you have permission to see. Keep the context of the people you connect with.
Find a shared photo and open the profile of the person who posted it.
Retrieve saved photos and frames, with their date and location. See where an object was last observed.
“Where were my documents last seen?” Ask and review the saved evidence.
Capture when you choose. Search by text or voice. Connect compatible glasses to bring RealityOS into your day.
Save a photo from your phone. Later, ask about what you captured.
